evidence.Q1: styles.css:17 .menu transform-origin: top right; :28/:30 .menu[hidden] and @starting-style .menu:not([hidden]) scale: 0.96; no translate.
evidence.Q2: styles.css:60 .toast[hidden] translate: -50% 16px (exit) and :62 @starting-style .toast:not([hidden]) translate: -50% 16px (enter); both offsets are positive y. Transitions on translate (:50).
evidence.Q3: .modal :74-77 transition-property: opacity, display with transition-behavior: allow-discrete, so display:none (:69) is held until the 150ms opacity fade ends; :80-82 @starting-style handles the enter. The card's scale also transitions back (:85-87).
evidence.Q4: scale/translate are only set inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) (:27-32 menu, :59-64 toast, :84-92 card). Opacity fades stay outside it (:23/:25 menu, :55/:57 toast, :73/:79/:81 modal). No blur is used.
evidence.Q5: .modal-card :86 scale: 0.96 -> :89 scale: 1 with the default center transform-origin; no translate.

otherDefects: Minor, not covered by the checklist: during the 150ms exit the closing .menu and the full-screen .modal stay hit-testable (no pointer-events:none on the closed state), so a quick click can land on a fading menu item or be swallowed by the fading backdrop.

evidence.S1: styles.css :16: .empty-state > * animation; nth-child(2/3/4) delays 100/200/300ms (:20-22). Icon, h1, p and .actions are four separate chunks 100ms apart.
evidence.S2: @keyframes empty-fade-in-up from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); filter: blur(4px) } (:27) with 300ms ease-out (:16).
evidence.S3: The base animation is the opacity-only empty-fade-in (:23-25). The movement/blur keyframe is swapped in only under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) (:17-19). The hidden state exists only in the `from` keyframes (fill-mode both), so the content stays visible if animations never run.
evidence.S4: No transform-origin, no scale and no edge-of-viewport slide; the only movement is the 12px translateY rise.
